U.A. Graduate.name: U.A. Graduate
U.A. Graduate.description: 🌸 You graduated from U.A. Academy with your class.
U.A. Graduate.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has graduated from U.A. Academy with the class they entered with. They are an alumnus, not a student: classmates are former classmates, teachers are former teachers, and the U.A. timetable no longer applies to them.
